name: european_open_momentum_continuation
mechanism: When London opens at 13:30 IST, European institutional desks begin routing directional orders into NIFTY's largest ADR/GDR-linked constituents — HDFC Bank, RELIANCE, ICICI Bank, INFOSYS, and TCS collectively represent ~38% of NIFTY's weight. Simultaneous institutional buying or selling of these five heavyweights creates a measurable directional impulse on the NIFTY index that persists for 30-120 seconds as domestic market makers delta-hedge and momentum algorithms pile in behind the initial European order flow. We enter in the direction of this impulse at 13:30 IST when the 30-minute pre-European-open momentum and session VWAP alignment both confirm the directional bias, capturing the first burst before the effect dissipates as US pre-market liquidity competes for attention from 14:30 IST onward.
core_signal_oneliner: European open (13:30 IST) directional burst: 30-min pre-open momentum + 2-min acceleration burst both align with VWAP-side
